metadata.title: Compact Vaisman and l.c.K. manifolds with nonnegative bisectional curvature
metadata.abstract: We study the structure of compact Vaisman and l.c.K. manifolds with nonnegative bisectional curvature in this paper. Our first main result (cf. Theorem 1.3) is a uniformization theorem for compact Vaisman manifolds, extending Mok's uniformization theorem in the Kähler setting (cf. [Mok88]). Our second result (cf. Theorem 1.6) gives a structural trichotomy for compact l.c.K. manifolds with nonnegative Chern bisectional curvature: the underlying complex manifold admits a Kähler metric, admits a Vaisman metric, or its universal cover is conformally equivalent to the product of an incomplete Kähler manifold and a positive-dimensional complex Euclidean space.

analysis.progressType: 非负双截曲率下的统一化
analysis.workSummary: 证明紧 Vaisman 流形的统一化，并给出非负 Chern 双截曲率紧 lcK 流形的 Kähler/Vaisman/覆叠乘积三分结构。
analysis.breakthrough: 把 Kähler 非负双截曲率统一化思想推进到特定非 Kähler 背景。
analysis.limitations: 三分结论包括不完备 Kähler 因子的覆叠情形，不能一概推为 Kähler 或 Vaisman。
